title: Time after time: flowering phenology and biotic interactions
notes: Review explicitly separates pollinator and predispersal-seed-predator effects on flowering phenology; 65 references provide a finite historical source universe.

title: Meta-analysis of phenotypic selection on flowering phenology suggests that early flowering plants are favoured
notes: Meta-analysis includes 87 species for flowering time and 18 for conspecific flowering synchrony; supporting Appendix S1/S2 contain effect sizes and original source references. Prior art does not estimate plant-partner temporal matching by interaction role.
